Yes — but you need to look for a **very specific type of sheet**, not just “split king.”

Here’s the deal:

- A regular **split king sheet set** = 2 separate fitted sheets (one for each side) + 1 flat sheet citeturn0news9  
- BUT for **adjustable beds where only the head moves independently**, you want:

👉 **“Split Head King” or “Flex Top King” sheets**

These are made with a **split only at the top portion** so each side can lift independently, while the rest stays connected.

---

## 🔑 What to search for (this is key)
- Split Head King sheets  
- Flex Top King sheets  
- Top Split King sheets  

---

## 🛏️ Good options you can buy

### Best budget-friendly (most common style)
product["turn0product0","Split Flex Head King Adjustable Sheet Set",{"render_as":"hero","description":"Affordable microfiber sheets designed specifically for split-head adjustable beds with flexible top section."}]

✔ Designed for head-only adjustable bases  
✔ Soft, stretchy microfiber (moves with the bed)  
✔ Great if you just want something easy + affordable  

---

### Higher-end / luxury feel
product["turn0product8","Egyptian Linens Bamboo Cotton Split King Sheets",{"render_as":"block","description":"Breathable bamboo-cotton blend sheets with a premium feel for adjustable split king beds."}]

✔ Cooler + more breathable  
✔ Better durability  
✔ Feels more like hotel-quality sheets  

---

### If you only want the fitted sheet (not a full set)
product["turn0product3","Split Head King Fitted Sheet Only",{"render_as":"block","description":"Single fitted sheet option designed for split-top adjustable mattresses."}]

✔ Good if you already have flat sheets you like  
✔ Works specifically for split-head setups  

---

## ⚠️ Important things to double-check
Before you buy, make sure:

- Your mattress is actually **Split Head / Flex Top** (not just split king)  
- Check **split length** (common is ~30–34 inches at the top)  
- Make sure pocket depth matches your mattress height  

---

## Bottom line
👉 Yes, you absolutely *can* buy them  
👉 You just need **“Split Head King / Flex Top King sheets”**, not standard split king

items.snippet: Split king sheets are made for split king beds, which consist of two twin mattresses that make up the size of a standard king bed but allow individual firmness and elevation adjustments. Split king sheet sets include two fitted sheets for each mattress, one king-sized flat sheet, and pillowcases. Popular materials for split king sheets include 100% cotton, Egyptian cotton, microfiber, flannel, and percale. Each material offers distinct benefits like breathability, durability, warmth, affordability, and comfort. Compared to a standard king sheet set, split king sets are slightly more expensive and take longer to make the bed due to the two mattresses.
